task.description:
Finalize GH-600 / ISS-0629 (TC-LUA-10-03 flaky test fix). Small, test-only change: bounded 1000ms yield-spin retry loop replaces a zero-tolerance assertion in src/lua/limiter_wiring_test.zig. Verified with 19 consecutive clean zig build test-lua runs across three independent agents (BACKEND-DEV 8, ORCH 3, TEST-RUNNER 8) against a pre-fix failure rate of roughly 40-67% observed in two independent pre-fix samples.

YOUR JOB:
1. Update CHANGELOG.md briefly -- this is a minor test-infrastructure fix, a short entry is appropriate (describe the flake and the fix: bounded retry replacing a zero-tolerance post-hoc assertion that raced against the LUA-10 watchdog thread's own polling interval).
2. No requirement IDs involved (test-only fix, not a requirement change) -- skip reqctl.py.
3. Skip retrospective (WF-03 run, no estimation.json).
4. GH-600 disposition: this issue's acceptance criteria (consistent passing across >=20 runs, OR the test restructured with bounded retry/backoff) are met by option (b), fully -- close it with 'Closes #600'.
5. GitHub Branch Management (MANDATORY Step Final): create the PR (gh pr create --base main), explain this is a small test-only flake fix in the body. Poll for genuine CI completion, squash-merge and delete branch, verify no orphaned branch, update project board for issue #600 (straight to done, non-UAT-scoped, fully resolved), return repo to clean main.
acceptance_criteria: PR created, CI verified genuinely green
